title: Figure Split Tiles
description: Add a general mechanism so a figure disposition can split into many crop-tiles with independent positions across arrangements (reveal.js auto-animate). Demonstrate in projektetage: catalogue figure splits into 3x5 grid, taken apart/scaled down, partial focus.
summary: Reveal.js dedupes auto-animate pairs that share the same target element, so shared columnMorphId only animated one tile per column. Added columnMorphTileId for per-tile data-id on focus tiles, morphColumnGroups to expand each column morphTarget into one stacked label slot per tile (companions invisible), and wired projektetage catalogue-labels. All tiles in a column now FLIP-morph into the same stacked label position.
